item.title: HDTX 2026: What Truck Fleet Managers Should Know About This Exclusive Industry Event
item.description: HDTX 2026 in Scottsdale, Arizona, offers heavy-duty trucking fleet managers educational sessions, structured supplier meetings, and industry insights. Learn what to expect at this exclusive event.

item.title: A Reefer Truck Driver’s Guide to Preventing Rejected Loads and Freight Claims
item.description: Learn how to prevent rejected loads and protect freight claims with this practical guide for reefer truck drivers. From pre-trip inspections and temperature settings to airflow management, monitoring, and FSMA-compliant documentation, these tips help drivers in reefer trucking jobs, CDL reefer jobs, and OTR reefer jobs keep shipments safe and compliant.

item.title: FMCSA Issues Warning on USDOT and MC Number Sales: What Drivers Need to Know
item.description: FMCSA is warning carriers and owner-operators not to sell or lease USDOT and MC numbers outside of legitimate transactions. Learn the risks, potential penalties, and how improper transfers can lead to revoked authority and liability issues in the trucking industry.

item.title: Flatbed Rates Surge as Spot Market Finds Its Footing
item.description: Flatbed spot rates hit their highest levels since 2022, leading the trucking spot market as demand and volumes climb. Explore the latest trends in flatbed, dry van, and refrigerated freight and what they mean for drivers and fleets.

item.title: TMC Honors Four Industry Leaders with Silver Spark Plug Award in Nashville
item.description: TMC honored four trucking professionals with the 2026 Silver Spark Plug award at ATA’s annual meeting in Nashville, recognizing excellence in fleet maintenance, technology, and industry leadership.

item.title: How to Turn CDL Training into Your First Trucking Job (Even with No Experience)
item.description: Start your trucking career the right way. Learn how to choose CDL training that leads to real entry-level trucking jobs, avoid common mistakes, and move from the classroom to your first paycheck with confidence.

item.title: Crawford Trucking and Fortigo Freight Services Named 2026 Best Fleets to Drive For
item.description: Crawford Trucking and Fortigo Freight Services earn top honors in the 2026 Best Fleets to Drive For awards. See what sets these fleets apart and why driver feedback matters.

item.title: 2026 Capitol Christmas Tree Will Roll Out of Idaho on a Cross-Country Trucking Journey
item.description: The 2026 Capitol Christmas Tree will travel from Idaho to Washington, D.C. Learn how this annual tradition highlights the trucking industry and the drivers behind the haul.

item.title: Volvo Signals Next Heavy-Haul Truck as Platform Rollout Continues
item.description: Volvo Trucks teases a next-generation VNX heavy-haul truck while expanding its platform, connectivity, and safety features. See what this means for drivers and fleets.

item.title: How Local Truck Drivers Can Cut Costs with Everyday Tech Tools on Short-Haul Routes
item.description: Learn how local truck drivers can cut costs on short-haul routes using everyday tech tools for parking, fuel savings, maintenance alerts, and traffic navigation.
